findings.claim: The shape guard accepts any `as` assertion, not specifically `as const`, so the completion criterion "object literal의 as const 선언임을 확인" is only checked as "object literal behind some type assertion".
findings.reproduction: In lib/publicChatMessage.ts change the trailing `} as const;` to `} as Record<string, unknown>;` and run `node --conditions=react-server --import tsx --test tests/memoryReleaseContracts.test.mjs`: the test still passes, whereas asserting `ts.isTypeReferenceNode(init.type) && init.type.typeName.getText() === "const"` would fail it. Harmless for the disclosure property (fields are still read from the literal), so no change is required.

findings.claim: `property.name.getText(...)` returns the raw key text, so a string-literal key form of the same allowlist entry would be recorded as `"memoryUsedCount"` (with quotes) and fail the assertion.
findings.reproduction: In lib/publicChatMessage.ts write `"memoryUsedCount": true,` instead of `memoryUsedCount: true,` and run the test file: it fails with "the owner's public-message allowlist must select memoryUsedCount (§13.4)". This errs strict (false negative only) and matches current source style, so it is recorded rather than actioned.
